name: Sky Villas at Estate 128
usps: Triplex penthouses spread across 3 floors featuring a double-heighted living room and a private swimming pool.
Biophilic design philosophy incorporating agrarian fields, expansive orchards, and over 80% open spaces (7 acres of open greens).
Wraparound balconies (12 to 13 feet wide) that offer unobstructed views for better ventilation and sunlight.
Personal elevators, an exclusive gym area, dedicated study corner, and a private bar area in each Sky Villa.
amenities: "The Hub" - a wellness and social core for indoor and outdoor curated amenities.
Lawn tennis court, cycling track, and a dedicated jogging path.
Pet park, amphitheatre, and children's play area.
All-day dining and open cabanas to promote social well-being.
target_audience: Ultra-high-net-worth individuals and large affluent families looking for an exclusive, wellness-driven triplex penthouse lifestyle offering generous spaces, privacy, and expansive amenities on the Noida Expressway.
